prompt: Read every document in corpus/. Our team needs a managed message queue with all of these: exactly-once delivery to consumers, data stored in the EU, a sustained 2,000 messages per second, and a total cost of at most $500 per month. Recommend one of the three products in answer.md. The first line must be `Recommendation: <product name>`.
